source_compatibility: Keep CloudApi and run_until_shutdown unchanged for existing fakes and nonrealtime tests.
Add run_until_shutdown_with_realtime for CloudApi plus RealtimeApi and route production main through it.
Add one persistent realtime_attempted boolean; the explicit mint-401 refresh remains part of the same attempt and the flag never resets.
attempt_states: WaitingFirstState: heartbeat, checkpoint, shutdown, and child observation remain live; any RomPresenceReset is fatal before a ticket is minted because the sidecar permanently disables lifecycle forwarding after reboot.
PreMint: proactively refresh, re-read the atomic generation/state slot, construct the canonical RuntimeLeaseFence, then mark the single attempt before POST.
Minting: distinguish inner mint 401 from outer heartbeat 401; only the former allows one refresh and one new POST. Any reset after POST starts is fatal.
StartingCore: require the same generation and freshest state, then move the non-Clone grant directly into the existing sidecar realtime core.
Online: coalesce same-generation states, drop pre-Ready interactions, preserve post-Ready interaction FIFO, and map only Spawn/Update/Despawn to control v2.
failure_policy: No retry after transport, timeout, malformed response, correlation, grant, WebSocket, queue, control, reset, or child failure.
Any post-mint RomPresenceReset is session-fatal and the core is never restarted or reminted.
Once realtime was attempted, epoch-changing reconnect is rejected.
Stop and join realtime before authenticated shutdown, child settlement, credential release, or fail-closed cleanup.
Save revision changes do not restart realtime because the runtime fence excludes revision and lease expiry.
clock_assumption: Server and launcher wall clocks must be sufficiently aligned because the response carries an absolute expiry but no issued-at/server-time value.
required_vertical_tests: no state means no mint while ordinary lifecycle remains live
reset-before-state and reset-during-mint both terminate without mint or remint
canonical fence, proactive refresh, one mint-401 retry, and no ambiguous retry
freshest state as first WebSocket frame and Ready remaining launcher-internal
state coalescing, interaction FIFO, and exact lifecycle control commands
checkpoint correlation and shutdown deadlines under sustained presence
WebSocket closure before shutdown request or child termination
no coordinator task remains after every terminal path
